name: Waldorf Tofu Salad Pitas with Mixed Greens & Red Grape Salad
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Juice one lemon into a large bowl (reserve remaining lemon for the mixed green salad). Add yogurt, mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Halve grapes and add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining grapes for the mixed green salad.)
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu salad. Set aside.
Juice the remaining lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, additional Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette.
Add mixed greens and reserved grapes to the bowl with the vinaigrette; toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; stuff each pocket with the tofu salad.
To serve, divide pitas and mixed green salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
